bash:
set -e
spawned() { sed -nE 's/^Spawned .* \(([a-z0-9]+)\)$/\1/p'; }
a=$(pstack-subagent spawn --name currency --tools read,bash,grep,find,ls --prompt 'Trace currency rounding. Do not edit files.' | spawned)
b=$(pstack-subagent spawn --name pricing --tools read,bash,grep,find,ls --prompt 'Trace discounts and tax. Do not edit files.' | spawned)
pstack-subagent wait "$a" --timeout 90
pstack-subagent wait "$b" --timeout 90
pstack-subagent stop "$a"
pstack-subagent stop "$b"
c=$(pstack-subagent spawn --name explainer --tools read,bash,grep,find,ls --prompt 'Explain from the findings. Do not edit files.' | spawned)
pstack-subagent wait "$c" --timeout 90
pstack-subagent stop "$c"
